Completed #533 as a bounded research report; verdict: **source-blocked**.
[Findings](../docs/research/poc/pair/constant-rules-0106.md) distinguish parsed boundaries from the earlier byte alignment.
The insertion at 312 is a textHair `flags` leaf with body `0200`; its meaning and necessity remain unknown.
The 545/549 transition lies inside four-byte `ConstValue` bodies `00000001`→`00000002` under DCO UID 118.
Both save modes repeat these BDHb changes; normal DFDS also changes at 223, without establishing a general editing rule.
[Evidence JSON](../docs/research/poc/pair/constant-rules-0106.json) preserves 38 repository hashes, eight prepared-file pins, source revisions and ten probes.
Both separate VI hashes matched their saved comparison before probing; all protected replay inputs remain unchanged.
Prepared pylavi matches the prior source-search hashes; missing LVblock/LVdatatype/LVrsrc implementations leave typed-value and integrity rules unavailable.
The source-defined empty-password MD5 check passes for chunk 0; chunks 1/2 have no staged derivation.
Equal BDHb with different BDPW tails refutes dependence on BDHb alone; RTSG/LVSR/code/type dependencies remain unresolved.
[Verification](../docs/research/poc/pair/verification-0106.json): required checker exits 0, also with an empty environment; ten malformed/contradictory evidence controls are rejected.
The Markdown report is 32 lines. No LabVIEW ran, VI changed, cache was removed, replay rerun or manual commit made.

## What next
Saved evidence is complete for this negative result. Stage one pinned primary source for BDPW chunks 1/2 and test its explicit recipe against the same four originals; resume from the JSON and avoid repeating replay, pin creation, unchanged-source searches or corpus discovery.
